hooks.name: Check v17 parity run completion
hooks.description: On session start, checks if the canonical_full_v17 parity run has completed by looking for the network checkpoint and writer lease status. Reports status so you know whether to run prove-exact.

action.command: python -c "import json,pathlib,sys; lease=pathlib.Path('workspace/runs/oracle_180709_E/canonical_full_v17/99_Metadata/writer_lease.json'); ckpt=pathlib.Path('workspace/runs/oracle_180709_E/canonical_full_v17/02_Output/python_results/checkpoints/checkpoint_network.pkl'); status='unknown'; msg=''; has_network=ckpt.exists(); lease_data=json.loads(lease.read_text()) if lease.exists() else {}; status=lease_data.get('status','no_lease'); stage=lease_data.get('stage','?'); print(json.dumps({'status':status,'stage':stage,'network_checkpoint_exists':has_network,'message':f'v17 Brioche: {status} (stage={stage}), network_ckpt={has_network}. Run prove-exact if network_ckpt exists.'}))"
